_source: ADU-MOB-01 v1.2 S3.7 and S18.1 gate 9, ADU-MOB-WO-01 v1.2 WO-0b S0b.6. Every dependency of apps/mobile is named here with WHY it is present and whether it is a data PROCESSOR (ADU-MOB-01 B2, S20.4; ADU-DPIA-01 S3.2). Gate 9 fails when package.json and this file disagree in either direction, and when any version is a range. A new dependency is a document change, not a code change: it is added here, in the PR, with its reason, before it is installed.

@adulis/api-client.why: The seam (ADU-REPO-01 S5.1): types generated from contracts/openapi.json. Never a hand-authored DTO.

@adulis/locale.why: The typed catalogue (S5.3): a missing Amharic key is a compile error.

expo.why: The SDK (ADU-MOB-01 S3.1): config plugins, EAS build, the update service. Pinned to SDK 57.

expo-camera.why: The QR scan, MB-21 (S3.7). Its plugin carries the camera purpose string.

expo-constants.why: Peer of expo-router; the app config at runtime.

expo-font.why: Loads the six bundled font files at runtime (B16, ADU-MOB-03 D3).

expo-linking.why: Peer of expo-router; the scheme and, once the domain exists, App Links.

expo-notifications.why: FCM and APNs registration, the permission, the tray (S3.7). The push service is the platforms' own -- an existing store relationship, not a new processor (B2).

expo-router.why: File-based routing: the directory IS the deep-link map (S3.2).

expo-secure-store.why: Keychain/Keystore for the session token and the device id (S3.7, S14.1).

expo-splash-screen.why: Holds the splash until the fonts are loaded.

expo-sqlite.why: ONE row: the order-creation idempotency key and its cart hash, in src/store/ (B6, S9.5, S17.2). Nothing else, ever.

expo-updates.why: Over-the-air JavaScript releases (S19.2, B21). Publication is CI-only from a tag (ADU-MOB-07 O3).

react.why: Pinned to the version Expo SDK 57 bundles.

react-native.why: Pinned to the version Expo SDK 57 bundles.

react-native-reanimated.why: Required peer of expo-router 57, pinned to the version SDK 57 bundles (4.5.1, which pairs with worklets 0.10.x); pnpm otherwise auto-installs the newest. No Adulis code animates with it (ADU-MOB-03 D8).

react-native-safe-area-context.why: Peer of expo-router; the safe-area inset is a layout input (ADU-MOB-03 D11).

react-native-screens.why: Peer of expo-router; native screen containers.

@babel/core.why: Required by babel-preset-expo; Metro and Jest transform through it.

@jest/globals.why: Tests import describe/it/expect explicitly instead of relying on injected globals, so tsc types them without @types/jest.

@react-native/metro-config.why: Peer of @react-native/community-cli-plugin, pinned to the version SDK 57 bundles (pnpm otherwise resolves the newest, which fails the peer range).

@testing-library/react-native.why: Renders components in Jest for the CI half of the screen gates.

jest.why: The unit test runner jest-expo presets.

jest-expo.why: Expo's Jest preset (S18.1: unit tests in the mobile job).

react-dom.why: Peer of expo-router (web target, unused here), pinned to the bundled React so the peer range is met; pnpm otherwise auto-installs the newest.

react-native-worklets.why: Required peer of expo-modules-core 57, pinned to the version SDK 57 bundles (0.10.1); pnpm otherwise auto-installs 0.12.1, which the SDK does not accept.

react-test-renderer.why: Peer of @testing-library/react-native 13, at the bundled React version.
